objectives.title: Gather wood
objectives.note: Teaches Interact; one or two trees.

objectives.title: Eat something
objectives.note: A hunger wait: the player eats once energy falls below 90, about a minute in.

objectives.title: Found a settlement
objectives.note: Fast when the wood was gathered while waiting to eat.

objectives.title: Reach the Village era
objectives.note: The Village era (EraRules): a village, 10 members, 2 stalls and day 3. Aimed at 10-20 minutes of play; measured 17 to 20 minutes from the start on seeds 1 to 15, the calendar setting the floor (settlers flock to a new nation, which was a village in two or three minutes before the day was required). Gating again now that a nation the player leads cannot be besieged before the Town era. Under 5 minutes would mean the era no longer waits for its day.

objectives.title: Sell resources at market
objectives.note: Waits for a settler to buy a stall and earn coins to pay with.

objectives.title: Grow your nation to 16
objectives.note: Advisory: recruiting slows once every settler has a nation (docs/PACING.md).

objectives.title: Amass 1000 coins
objectives.note: Advisory. Raised from 500 to 1,000 for the Village era: the arc's rewards and treasuries passed 500 before it came up.

objectives.title: Reach the Town era
objectives.note: The Town era: a town, 18 members, 2 settlements, 1,000 funds and day 7. Aimed at about an hour; see docs/PACING.md for the measured times. Often reached before the ambition comes up, so no minimum. Advisory: on some seeds recruiting stalls short of 18 members.

objectives.title: Grow your nation to 25
objectives.note: Advisory: the Kingdom era's members, which the bot is slow to recruit.
